title: ZIP's traditional DOS time records seconds in two seconds
summary: The low five bits of the 16-bit time field store seconds divided by two, with minutes and hours in higher bits.
applies: Units and epochs of common timestamp fields
detail: Two adjacent seconds within the same minute may be represented by the same codable even seconds value. Traditional DOS time fields do not record time zones separately.
boundary: Extra timestamp fields may store UTC times and different precisions, and all record sources cannot be covered with traditional fields.
relevance: Explains why modification times can differ by a second or by a time zone offset after archiving.
